div.div:
أَلْتٌ Deficiency: as in the saying, مَا فِى مَزَاوِدِهِمْ أَلْتٌ [There is not, in their provision-bags, any deficiency]. (A.) ＝
-A2- A swearing; syn. حَلِفٌ (M, TA.) [Perhaps an inf. n. in this sense.] ―
-b2- An oath: as in the saying, when one has not given thee thy right, or due, قَيِّدْهُ بِالْأَلْتِ [Bind thou him by oath]. (T.) ＝
-A3- Calumny, slander, or false accusation. (Kr, M, K.) [Perhaps an inf. n. in this sense also.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
